title: Fleet Rung 41 — THE MESH MARKET: the fleet trades on our own ledger. The owner demanded a networked arbitrage market for the agents and the soldiers — "שוק ארביטראז רישתי עבור הסוכנים והחיילים זאת אומרת שנסחר גם פה וגם שם וגם שם" — a wide volume of REAL trades and profits on our own network, and routers that can take and swap large sums. R39 built the ROUTER (venue graph, honest verdicts), R40 built the CORE (atomic settlement, the real-value vault). R41 builds the DEMAND SIDE: arb-mesh.cjs — the roster (headcorner + the ten soldiers from persona-slots) becomes the market itself on our own DEX. MANDATE LAW (deterministic, zero magic numbers): for every pool-side edge row that clears the inherited FLOOR law (verdict CANDIDATE-FOK), the mesh drafts intents for the whole roster — the operator commands 40% of the row's budget, the soldiers split 60% equally, the row budget is the catalog quote size (~1% of first-hop depth of the input asset). DIRECTION LAW: pool mid > fair ⇒ sell the base into the pool (edge is captured trading TOWARD the fair, never against it). WIRE LAW (the smart-treasury behavior): an agent who cannot cover his mandate is armed by a MESH-WIRE from the treasury's free claims — capped at 10% of free per batch, partial wires shrink the fill, conservation moves claims and never creates them; no capital ⇒ the honest GATED-WIRE verdict, never a fake trade. SETTLEMENT: the mesh writes the intents queue (atomic tmp+rename) and the core settles it in a fresh process (dex-core.cjs settle-intents) — settleIntents in dex-core.cjs v1.1.0: batch-idempotent (processedBatches memo, a replayed batch settles nothing twice), no naked shorts (NAKED-SHORT-REFUSED), dust refused, a fill never above 5% of first-hop depth (DEPTH-CAP), every hop + minOut settle all-or-nothing on simulated copies (a refused minOut leaves pools AND accounts byte-unchanged — the wire is applied only at commit), agent accounts born lazily at first real movement, edge marked honest-or-null (PEG legs 1:1, STEEM/SBD to the CEX-implied fair when the feed is fresh, everything else null — P&L measured, never guessed), pool feeMeter accrues per fill (LP revenue), conservation asserted after every fill, attestation recomputed. Keyed rails are NEVER fired by the keyless mesh (PLAN-KEYED-RAIL rows, the signing desks own those); grid rungs stay PLAN-POOL-GATED-NOT-BROADCAST. SIZE LADDER (the large-sums law): for every live pair, exact BigInt quotes at 0.1%/1%/5% of input-side depth with honest signed slippage — capability measured, not promised. Operator pipe-proof booked on the live ledger: batch MESH-OPERATOR-PIPEPROOF-R41 — headcorner STEEM 5000µ → 4993µ WSTEEM via P1 (MESH-WIRE + AGENT_FILL, conservation OK, attestation d6d5c769bf229029), the queue consumed and cleared by the core (single-writer handoff).
